verdict.rationale: Airweave's evidence covers collections, source connections, and search modes, but nothing describes memory sharing between agents/users with private-vs-team scoping or any permissions/tenancy model for selective sharing. Community comments even raise unanswered concerns about data isolation/leakage rather than confirming a shared/private memory boundary. Missing for 10: explicit shared vs private memory scoping, per-user/per-agent access controls, documentation of team/group memory concept.
